description: Managed device driver for the Shure ULXD4Q 4-channel UHF wireless receiver.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: Shure header, stock Cognio controls.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect button: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on. Flash is now Identify.
Connected lights only after the receiver answers, and a receiver that stops answering is dropped and retried.
More compact control panel (620 x 850, down from 670 x 1300).
Removed the decorative icons; the IP field is now labelled "Set Control IP".
No change to the driver script or controls.
